tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.kin.0: Tied it down, have you, %s? I'd know one of ours anywhere.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.kin.1: No need to hide it from me. I do the same in town.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.kin.2: You can fool the humans. You can't fool your own nose.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.haven.0: You can wrap it up all you like, %s. We can smell a tail here.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.haven.1: Let it out, friend. Nobody here will scream.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.haven.2: Hiding it even here? Old habits.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.hunter.0: Musk and fur, under all that cloth. I've tracked worse than you, %s.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.hunter.1: My dogs would have your scent in a breath. There's a tail on you.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.hunter.2: You're not what you look like, are you?
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.tribe.0: Sniff sniff. Tail-man! Hiding it, ha!
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.tribe.1: You stink of tail, %s. Why tie it? Nobody cares here.
tail.jaymoskingdoms.smelled.tribe.2: Something with a tail. Under the coat. We smell it.
